_why: Segments the eval set should not be scored on, and why. Checked in, because each entry is a judgement about the audio that only a person who was there can make, and it has to travel with the repo rather than live in someone's head. A segment listed here still exists and is still labelled correctly in production; it is simply not a fair question to ask a recogniser.
_rules: Exclude for what the AUDIO is, never for how the recogniser did on it. A tune that is hard is the point of the exercise; a tune that was never really played is not.
A wrong label is not an exclusion. Fix it in the segmenter and re-pull.
Say who decided and when, so an entry can be revisited rather than inherited.

excluded.reason: One player alone, starting and stopping several times rather than playing the tune through. Not a session performance, so not a fair test of recognising one.
